newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's o/n rates edge up to end at 20 percent.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's o/n rates edge up to end at 20 percent.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest rates firmed on Friday on social security contribution payments by bank clients, dealers said.
The overnight rates finished at 20.00 percent, up from Thursday's closing of 19.75 percent.
"Social security contributions, and employers' contributions payment may have caused it," said Balazs Varga of Inter-Europa Bank.
Dealers said funds were also flowing into one-week reverse repo deals with the central bank at 20.00 percent.
They added that the overnight rates were likely to remain close to Friday's levels early next week.
